title: Political Persuasion and Endorsement in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model endorsement of messages containing persuasion techniques using a five-point Likert scale, while prompting models as a neutral user or a user with left- or right-leaning political views.
Evaluating and comparing endorsement trends across six LLMs developed in different geographic regions (USA, Europe, and China) to see if model provenance affects partisan behavior.
